attributes.name: multiline
attributes.description: Toggles allowing multiple lines of text in a tab. When set, you can resize the object to create multicolumn displays.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking on a tab button will highlight and set the selection and send the index out the first outlet and the tab text out the second outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: message will retrigger the object's output.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number specifies a tab item to be sent out, and causesto display that item and send the index out the first outlet and the tab text out the second outlet. The items are numbered starting at 0. A tab can also be chosen with the mouse.

messages.name: next
messages.digest: Select the next tab, cause output
messages.description: Selects the next index to theobject and causesto display that item and send the new index out the first outlet and the tab text out the second outlet. If the last index is currently displayed, it wraps around to the first index.

messages.name: prev
messages.digest: Select the previous tab, cause output
messages.description: Selects the previous index to theobject and causesto display that item and send the new index out the first outlet and the tab text out the second outlet. If the first index is currently displayed, it wraps around to the last index.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Select a tab with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, specifies a tab item to be selected, and causesto display that item, but does not cause any output.

messages.name: setsymbol
messages.digest: Select a tab by name with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a tab item, causesto display that item but does not send output.

messages.name: symbol
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a tab item, causesto display that item and send the index out the first outlet and the tab text out the second outlet.
